text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"When I was little, I used to play a lot 
in the hospital garden and courtyard."

text_block_list.name: Inpatient A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ma-chan. You're here again, I see.

text_block_list.name: Young Chan
text_block_list.text:
Grandma, are you the person who gave me 
candy the other day?

text_block_list.name: Inpatient A
text_block_list.text: My, oh my, you remembered?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The patients were all so kind and talked 
to me often."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"‘A hospital is a place where life flows. 
It is born, it flows, and it goes to the 
sea.’"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"This is a matter of course and nothing to 
be afraid of. That is what I was taught."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And so, right in the middle of all that 
bustle, Chan-chan came to realize 
something."

text_block_list.name: Inpatient Y
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ma-chan. You're here again, I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
... Grandma, are you the person who gave 
me something before?

text_block_list.name: Inpatient Y
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, I've never given anything, but... 
Was there someone who did?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Who was where, what they were doing, and 
what they were talking about. Things like 
that..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Going out to sea and vanishing beyond 
sight... means being forgotten someday."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And that it is... a truly terrifying 
thing."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...What should I do? What should I do, 
what should I do, what should I do—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Will you never forget me? Will you... 
remember me...?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(It can't just be a simple memory. It has 
to be something that lasts... even 
longer—)

text_block_list.name: Nurse A
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, look at this mascot plushie! I 
was cleaning my room and found this blast 
from the past!

text_block_list.name: Nurse B
text_block_list.text:
Wah! What a throwback~! It's Carroty, the 
carrot fairy! That was super popular back 
then!

text_block_list.name: Nurse A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that one everyone had! I loved the 
lore too. A little clumsy, but super cute—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Hahaha~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The memorable first day marking the start 
of our challenge in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka—an Umamusume who stands head and 
shoulders above the rest of her generation 
and pursues sheer coolness—and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She roped in Daiwa Scarlet, an honor 
student in both racing and academics, to 
shoot an independent film.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hold it right there, master spy Chan! 
Today of all days, I won't let you get 
away!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let myself get caught! I must 
deliver this top-secret data to 
headquarters!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Hup!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan—or rather, "Machan, 
Top-Secret Spy"— dashes out into the 
wasteland with a dramatic line.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-... "Hold it~~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the script, it's the scene 
where the ace spy, Chan, deftly makes her 
daring escape from her pursuers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the stage direction, 'I'm 
running away for real, so chase me for 
real,' the pace of the two pursuers was 
relentlessly fast—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Moreover, Aston Machan's own speed was 
just like in an actual race!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pitch running style that gradually 
builds up speed by turning the legs over 
rapidly and quickly kicking off the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to her high cadence, her busy, 
earnest stride was endearing and somewhat 
admirable, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steadily pulling away from her pursuers 
with overwhelming speed. Overwhelming 
power.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was so captivated that I completely 
forgot we were in the middle of a 
photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah, haah...! Urghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her good form was short-lived; whether she 
ran out of stamina halfway through or not, 
she unsteadily lost speed and—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Secured!!" his

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Jeez, you can't catch me anymore, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was hopelessly captured by the two 
relentless pursuers.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought we could hold out until the end, 
but... Time to reset. Let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We are starting as soon as the break ends. 
We still have the movie merchandise 
photoshoot, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Merch? They're making merch for this movie 
too?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a necessary step to becoming an 
ultra-super mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a marketing strategy. I studied it. 
The book said: "To sell merchandise, you 
need a story."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is why I have made a plan. A very 
special one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan then proudly began explaining 
her "plan."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First, we make a movie with a great story. 
We also make merch. Merch for a beloved 
movie sells. That generates great sales 
data.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"We will take that sales data and go 
negotiate directly with the staff at the 
URA Planning and Production Department."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Having a mascot made by the URA is 
reserved for Umamusume with great track 
records.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even in the worst-case scenario where 
that's missing, adults will still move if 
we show them peak sales data. Definitely, 
probably, for sure—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Presumably.
choice_data_list: So... you're starting with an indie film?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A journey of a thousand miles begins with 
a single step.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I know you've been thinking about a lot 
of things, but won't it be pretty tough 
balancing racing with those kinds of 
activities?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, one option is to narrow our focus to 
just one race and wait for offers to come 
in. That would certainly be easier, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming an Ultra Super Mascot 
is veeery long, you see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Unless we exhaust every possible measure, 
we won't make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...You could say she's in a rush to live. 
However, it's also a manifestation of her 
strong will to see things through to the 
end.
choice_data_list: So this is how Chan does things, huh.
So this is how Chan does things, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I'm sorry, it was 
tasteless of me to meddle like that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Do your best in your own way, Chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I turned to look at Aston Machan. ...Yet, 
for some reason, she was nowhere to be 
seen.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ......Not again... ......Wait, again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with the two of them, who seemed 
quite used to this, I wandered around the 
area to pass the time until it was time to 
head back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home that day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I asked Aston Machan about her goals 
in the Twinkle Series to make sure we were 
aligned—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going for the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An answer came immediately.
choice_data_list: (And on top of that, the Triple Tiara...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara means conquering all 
three titles... the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and 
the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grand stage where the strongest of their 
generation gather, all aiming for the very 
top. It is by no means an easy prize to 
seize. However—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan is lovely, and it suits a 
glamorous atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Above all... that crown shines so 
brilliantly. It leaves an indelible mark, 
both in our hearts and in the record 
books.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Offers for mascot adaptations should be 
coming in no time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall aim for the Triple 
Tiara. Nay, I must.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And so, with that... please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind her gentle tone, I could feel an 
unyielding resolve that brooked no 
objection.
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's make sure we win it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. If it's Machan, it's not impossible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our immediate goal is the Triple 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days of rigorous training 
began, all to prepare for the battles 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Incidentally, the independent film was 
a complete flop.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...34 views. UmaTube truly is a 
terrifying realm...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming an Ultra Super Mascot 
is long.
